answer: If you cancel your booking now, you will get a full refund if you cancel up to 7 days before the arrival date. For cancellations between 7 days and 48 hours before arrival, you will receive a 50% refund. For cancellations within 48 hours of arrival, there is no refund. Refunds are processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For bookings made through Airbnb or Booking.com, the cancellation policy shown on your platform booking applies. For direct bookings, the security deposit is refunded within 3 business days after check-out, minus any damage or fees. The host decides on refunds, compensation, and other decisions. Please check the house manual for more details.
